note: Charville CODEX, Wu et al. 2022, Zenodo 13179600, CC-BY-4.0; real cells, downsampled

meta.label: MEASURED cells
meta.selection: 36 cores, one per patient: Charville_c003_v001_r001_reg112 (CHV-24133, the 3D view's region) plus 35 patients drawn uniformly (seed 7), each patient's largest region
meta.downsampling: uniform random sample of at most 1200 cells per core without replacement, seed 7; the pick core keeps every cell
meta.units: x, y integer microns from the region's bounding-box min; size_um the bounding box
meta.marker_scale: q = clip(round((v - lo) / (hi - lo) * 255), 0, 255); v the source's normalised intensity, lo/hi its 1st/99th percentile over the exported cells
